propositions: The rebar-debug skill does not currently instruct the agent to isolate work in a fresh worktree, allowing reproduction and fixes to land on stale branches in the primary checkout.
A setup directive must be added at the very start of skill execution to switch to a fresh worktree based on origin/main using the git worktree mechanism.
The skill documentation must name the concrete git worktree command (git worktree add) rather than describing the concept abstractly.
The two-phase debugging protocol (Phase 2 writes RED test + fix) remains semantically unchanged; only the initial setup instruction is added.
